text: 金十数据10月16日讯，李强主持召开国务院常务会议，会议讨论并原则通过《中华人民共和国教师法（修订草案）》，决定将草案提请全国人大常委会审议。会议指出，教师是立教之本、兴教之源，要切实强化教师待遇权益保障，减轻教师非教育教学任务负担，加强对教师的社会公共服务，维护好教师职业尊严和合法权益。要培养造就高素质专业化教师队伍，健全教师教育体系，提高教书育人能力，强化师德师风建设，在全社会营造尊师重教的良好氛围。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 16 - Li Qiang presided over a State Council executive meeting. The meeting discussed and approved in principle the Teachers Law of the People's Republic of China (Revision Draft) and decided to submit the draft to the NPC Standing Committee for deliberation. The meeting noted that teachers are the foundation of education and the source of its prosperity, and that it is necessary to effectively strengthen safeguards for teachers' compensation and rights, reduce the burden of non-teaching tasks on teachers, enhance social and public services for teachers, and protect teachers' professional dignity and lawful rights and interests. It is necessary to cultivate a high-quality professional teaching workforce, improve the teacher education system, enhance teaching and educating capabilities, strengthen teacher ethics and conduct, and create a good atmosphere of respecting teachers and valuing education throughout society.
